title: Imperial Star Destroyer — The Capture
description: A double-wedge Imperial warship with an armoured dorsal spine, eight twin turbolasers, the unmistakable T-shaped command bridge and twin spherical shield generators. Three large and four auxiliary engines finish the stern. A white and dark-red blockade runner flies beneath the port bow beside the recessed docking bay; both ships lift on compact display supports.

sections.name: Blockade runner — beneath the port bow
